#### vs Alternatives

I chose NotchNook because it offers the most complete and polished experience for making use of the MacBook notch. Compared to other alternatives, it feels more refined, better integrated with macOS, and more thoughtfully designed. The combination of widgets, media controls, and the tray feature makes it stand out as both practical and innovative.

Pedro Otávio

#### What's great

Really cool app! Finally the Mac notch has an actual use. Tons of widgets, a file shelf, live actions, it's all there and it just works. They also nailed the performance side, CPU and battery usage are super reasonable now. One of those apps you install and then wonder how you lived without it. Highly recommend!

Gustavo R.H.A

#### What's great

NotchNook is a fantastic productivity enhancer for Mac users! It smartly turns the MacBook notch into a useful utility space with widgets, calendar events, music controls, and a customizable “Tray” feature — making it feel like a mini Dynamic Island right in macOS.

Users on Product Hunt love how intuitive and practical it is — especially the media + calendar combo and the tray utility for managing screenshots and files. This makes daily workflows smoother and more enjoyable.

The interface feels polished and modern, and the feature set makes excellent use of the otherwise unused notch area. NotchNook adds both functionality and personality to your Mac setup.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants more from their Mac’s notch!
